updated.name: Hero Advantage
updated.rules: Heroes only. Use when entering Combat as the defender. Instead of drawing 3 cards from your life deck, draw the top 3 cards from your discard pile. If there are not enough cards in the discard pile, this card cannot be used. Remove from the game after use.
